Short title, extent and commencement

THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
ORDINANCE No. VIII OF 1948
[13th February, 1948]
An Ordinance to make provision for the constitution of a
Special Police Force for Pakistan.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Special
Police Establishment Ordinance, 1948.
[Subs. by
the Central Laws (Statue Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s.3 and 2nd
Sch., for the original sub-section (2) (with effect from the 14th
October, 1955)] [(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.]
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Constitution and powers of special police establishment

THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
ORDINANCE No. VIII OF 1948
[13th February, 1948]
An Ordinance to make provision for the constitution of a
Special Police Force for Pakistan.
2. Constitution and powers of
special police establishment.‑(1) Notwithstanding anything in the
Police Act, 1861, the Central Government may constitute a special police force
to be called the Pakistan Special Police Establishment for [The original words "the investigation in the Provinces
of Pakistan of have successively been amended by the Central Laws (Statute
Reform) Ordi nance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. and the Anti‑Corruption
Laws Amendment Act, 1965 (12 of 1965), s. 2 and Sch., to read as above.]
[inqui ry into, and investigation of] offences notified under section 3. V of
1861.
[Subs. by
Act 12 of 1965, s. 2 and Sch., for the original sub‑section (2), as
amended by Ordinance 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch.] [(2) Subject to any
order which the Central Government may make in this behalf, members of the
Pakistan Special Police Establishment shall, for the purpose of any inquiry or
investigation under sub‑section (1), have throughout Pakistan all the
powers of search, arrest of persons, and seizure of property and all other
powers, duties, privileges and liabilities which the police officers of a
Province have in connection with the investigation of offences:
Provided that no
member of the Special Police Establish ment shall have any power to inquire
into the bank accounts of any person:]
(3) Any member of the said police
establishment of or above the rank of Sub‑Inspector may, subject to any
orders which the Central Government may make in this behalf, exercise in [The original words the Provinces of omitted by Ordinance
21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).] *
*. * Pakistan any of the powers of the Officer‑in‑charge of a
police station in the area in which he is, for the time being and when so
exercising such powers shall, subject to any such orders as aforesaid, be
deemed to be all Officer‑in‑charge of a police station: discharging
the functions of such an officer within the limits of his station.

Offences to be investigated by special police establishment

THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
ORDINANCE No. VIII OF 1948
[13th February, 1948]
An Ordinance to make provision for the constitution of a
Special Police Force for Pakistan.
3. Offences to be investigated
by special police establishment. The Central Government may, by
notification in the official Gazette, specify [For
classes of offences specified under this section, see Gaz. of P., 1948, Pt. 1,
p. 455; ibid., 1949, Pt. 1, p. 275; ibid., Ext., 1954, p. 69; ibid., 1956,
Ext., pp. 1349‑135; and ibid., 1959, Ext., p. 1413.] the offences
or classes of offences com mitted in connection with matters concerning the [Subs. by the Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1965 (10 of
1965), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for Central and Provincial Governments .] [Central
Government] which are to be investigated by the Pakistan Special Police
Establishment.

Superintendence and administration of special police establishment

THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
THE PAKISTAN SPECIAL POLICE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE, 1948
ORDINANCE No. VIII OF 1948
[13th February, 1948]
An Ordinance to make provision for the constitution of a
Special Police Force for Pakistan.
4. Superintendence and
administration of special police establishment.‑(1) The
superintendence of the Pakistan Special Police Establishment shall vest in the
Central Government.
(2) The administration of the
said police establishment shall vest in an officer appointed in this behalf by
the Central Government who shall exercise in respect of that police estab lishment
such of the powers exercisable by an Inspector‑General of Police in
respect of the police force in a Province, as the Cen tral Government may
specify in this behalf.
[New sub‑section
(3) added by the Pakistan Special Police Establish ment (Amdt.) Ordinance, 1960
(19 of 1960), s. 2.] [(3) Any officer appointed under sub‑section
(2) may, by order in writing, direct that any power exercisable by him under
that sub‑section shall, in such circumstances and under such conditions,
if any, as may be specified in the order, be exercisable also by any officer
subordinate to him.]
